title: Size not known at compile time error
prompt: What causes error `E0277` when attempting to put `dyn Trait` into a struct or vector?
answer: Error `E0277` occurs because `dyn Trait` is a dynamically sized type whose size is unknown at compile time. Rust requires types stored directly in vectors or struct fields to have a constant size. You must wrap the trait object in a pointer like `Box<dyn Trait>` or `&dyn Trait`.
